verdicts.label: A
verdicts.evidence: The maximum size of a non-diverse set of flags is 64. For example, any set of 64 flags that all have a 1 in the first column and a 0 in the second column will not have a matching for color 0 (because the first column only has 1s) nor for color 1 (because the second column only has 0s). Thus, M must be at least 65.

verdicts.label: B
verdicts.evidence: The maximum size of a non-diverse set is 64, achieved by flags with c_1=1 and c_2=0. Any set of size 65 must be diverse.
